name: Well of Wisdom
tagline: Every learner drinks from their own well.
summary: Open-source, AI-first learning for families, classrooms, schools, co-ops and tutors. Build a full course from any topic, taught through what each learner loves, and let them play it as a world. Self-host with one command, or run it fully offline.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom: open-source AI learning for every kind of teacher
pages.description: Turn any topic into a full course shaped around what each learner loves, then let them play it as a world. Spaced review, a tutor with your rules, reports that print. Open source. Self-host free.

pages.title: Every feature in Well of Wisdom
pages.description: The complete list: Course Studio and lenses, learning paths, lessons with vocabulary, listening, translation, dialogue, graded readers and spoken answers, worlds and boss fights, a Socratic tutor, spaced review, reports and attendance, roles for groups, and open, portable, self-hosted AI.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for families and homeschools
pages.description: A curriculum that bends to what your child loves, with spaced review, printable portfolios and attendance your state will accept. Your data stays on your server.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for classroom teachers
pages.description: Generate courses from sources you choose, review every word before students see it, and see who is stuck on what. Reports and work samples print for the office.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for schools and districts
pages.description: Run AI-assisted courses on your own servers with your own AI provider or fully offline. Roles for teachers, tutors and observers, spend caps, and no student data on someone else's platform.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for co-ops and microschools
pages.description: One place for many families and teachers. Share courses once, keep each learner's work and reports separate, and give tutors access to only their own students.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for tutors and learning centers
pages.description: Build a course around one student's interests in minutes, see exactly where they slip, and hand parents a report built from real work.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for self-learners
pages.description: Teach yourself anything through what you already love, with review that brings back what you are about to forget and a tutor that hints before it tells.

pages.title: Well of Wisdom for developers and IT
pages.description: AGPL-3.0, Node and Postgres, one Docker image. Any OpenAI-compatible model, Claude, Gemini or local Ollama. A public course API, a portable course format and llms.txt.

pages.title: Self-host Well of Wisdom in one command
pages.description: Run Well of Wisdom on your own server with docker compose up -d. Bring any AI endpoint or run fully offline with Ollama. Your data stays yours.

pages.title: Open courses from Well of Wisdom
pages.description: Free courses published under open licences. Read them, download the package, and import them into your own Well of Wisdom.

pages.title: Privacy policy: Well of Wisdom
pages.description: What Well of Wisdom stores, what leaves your server, and how to delete it.

pages.title: Terms of service: Well of Wisdom
pages.description: Terms for using Well of Wisdom. AGPL-3.0, free to self-host. You own your course content.

pages.title: Children's data: Well of Wisdom
pages.description: How children's data is handled in Well of Wisdom. Less data is better, and a parent or teacher is in charge.

pillars.title: Course Studio
pillars.line: Any topic becomes a full course, shaped around what the learner loves.

features.name: AI course generation
features.detail: Topic, grade, lens and sources in; units, lessons, exercises and a project out in about a minute.

features.name: Lenses
features.detail: Teach fractions through sewing or physics through skateboarding. Every example and word problem follows the interest.

features.name: Grounded in your sources
features.detail: Paste a chapter or add links, and lessons stay close to what you gave it.

features.name: Worksheet import
features.detail: Paste any worksheet and each question becomes a graded exercise with a hint and an explanation.

features.name: Photo to worksheet
features.detail: Snap a printed page; a vision model reads it to text you correct before it becomes exercises.

features.name: Review before anyone sees it
features.detail: Every generated word is editable, and a course with a missing answer key cannot be published.

features.name: Reading level rewrite
features.detail: Rewrite any article up or down a reading level in one step.

pillars.title: Learning paths
pillars.line: Plan a unit, a term or a whole year, then generate each course when it is time.

features.name: Plan Assistant
features.detail: Describe the subject, goals, timeframe and learners; get a milestone sequence to review.

features.name: Templates with no AI needed
features.detail: Algebra 1, US History, Biology, Intro to Python and Creative Writing, ready to use.

features.name: One path, many learners
features.detail: Each learner gets their own lens and instructions on the same path.

features.name: Calendar
features.detail: Sessions, deadlines, field trips and exams on one month grid with milestone dates.

pillars.title: Lessons that teach
pillars.line: Real maths, real video, real projects, and help that nudges before it tells.

features.name: Articles with real maths
features.detail: Typeset formulas that screen readers can read aloud, not images of equations.

features.name: Answers that understand kids
features.detail: Numeric answers accept 5/8, 1 3/4 and $3.50. Multiple choice and written self-checks too.

features.name: Video with questions
features.detail: YouTube, Vimeo, PeerTube or your own upload, with captions and questions at the right moment.

features.name: Audio lessons
features.detail: Narrated lessons with a transcript for every clip.

features.name: Vocabulary cards
features.detail: Word, form, gloss and example at A1 to B2, with image and audioText, spaced review, and alternatives accepted.

features.name: Listen and choose
features.detail: Hear audioText or a local clip, then pick the right choice. Six choices at most, graded on the server.

features.name: Listen and repeat
features.detail: Hear the expected phrase, then repeat. Scored by words correct in order, accents folded, with typed or STT transcript.

features.name: Translate
features.detail: Short translation with en_to_es, en_to_fr and back, exact match on expected or alternatives, or flagged for guide rubric review.

features.name: Dialogue
features.detail: Short role play conversation in scene, 1 to 6 turns with goals and good endings, hints and tutor keep them in character.

features.name: Graded readers
features.detail: CEFR leveled reader with tap a word glosses, A1 to C2, with word and gloss length checks.

features.name: Speak your answer
features.detail: Push to talk on any answer: hold, speak, see the transcript and confirm before it is graded. Number words become digits and fractions, letter names pick a choice, all on the server.

features.name: Projects and hand-ins
features.detail: Rubric-based projects the learner submits and the guide returns with feedback.

features.name: Hints and Why was I wrong?
features.detail: A nudge first, then an explanation that walks from the learner's mistake to the right idea.

features.name: Read aloud and print
features.detail: Every article reads aloud, and every lesson prints as a worksheet for screen-free days.

pillars.title: Worlds to play
pillars.line: The course becomes a place: a path to walk, a story to finish, a boss to beat.

features.name: Four kinds of game
features.detail: Story, dungeon crawl, RPG party, or choose your own path. A wrong turn is a longer road, never a dead end.

features.name: Worlds from the classics
features.detail: Wonderland, Oz, Sherlock Holmes, Treasure Island and more, each tied to a real course.

features.name: Boss fights on real questions
features.detail: Bosses are beaten with correct answers, not button presses.

features.name: Path map and mastery stars
features.detail: Walk the course as a trail, with doors between units and stars for mastered lessons.

features.name: Dailies, weeklies and streaks
features.detail: Small goals, badges earned from real work, and loot with lore to collect.

features.name: Real-world rewards
features.detail: The guide sets rewards that matter at home or in class, unlocked by the learner's progress.

features.name: Voice and music
features.detail: Optional narrated scenes and a music loop per chapter, silent until the learner taps.

pillars.title: A tutor with your rules
pillars.line: A Socratic tutor that asks before it answers, set per learner by the adult in charge.

features.name: Three modes
features.detail: Hints only, guided, or full explanations, chosen for each learner.

features.name: The answer stays private
features.detail: In the strict modes the answer key is never sent to the AI model at all.

features.name: Every conversation visible
features.detail: Guides read every transcript from the tutor log.

pillars.title: Memory that lasts
pillars.line: Review arrives right before a learner would forget, across every course.

features.name: Spaced review
features.detail: Every graded answer is scheduled 1, 3 and 7 days out, then longer. Mistakes come back today.

features.name: One practice queue
features.detail: A single due-now list across all of a learner's courses.

features.name: Misconception spotting
features.detail: See which wrong answers several learners share, so you reteach the idea, not the question.

features.name: Live progress
features.detail: Lessons, accuracy and active days per learner, per course.

pillars.title: Records that print
pillars.line: Reports, portfolios and attendance built from real work, ready for whoever asks.

features.name: Progress reports
features.detail: Stats from real work plus a narrative you edit, printable with signature lines.

features.name: Portfolios
features.detail: Work samples with the guide's own feedback for any date range.

features.name: Attendance
features.detail: Instruction days derived from work, editable per day, with a CSV export.

features.name: Assessments
features.detail: Test results and evaluations stored exactly as they were given.

features.name: Rubric grading
features.detail: AI drafts feedback on essays and projects; the guide edits and sends it.

features.name: Email digests
features.detail: Weekly summaries and next-day reminders for guides, and optional notes for learners.

pillars.title: Built for groups
pillars.line: One family, one class, or thirty families, with the right access for each adult.

features.name: Roles
features.detail: Owner, guide, assistant who sees only assigned learners, and read-only observer.

features.name: No email for learners
features.detail: Learners sign in with a group code, a username and a PIN.

features.name: View as learner
features.detail: Walk any learner's screen without being able to change their work.

features.name: Workspace and library
features.detail: Nested notes pages and a resource library with table, board, calendar and gallery views.

features.name: Comfortable for every reader
features.detail: Dark mode, reading size, an easier-letters font, line spacing and themes.

pillars.title: Open and yours
pillars.line: Your server, your AI, your data, and courses that travel without a platform.

features.name: Self-host in one command
features.detail: docker compose up -d starts the app and its database.

features.name: Any AI, or none
features.detail: Any OpenAI-compatible model, Claude, Gemini, or fully offline with Ollama. Without AI, templates, lessons, review and records still work.

features.name: Spend you can see
features.detail: Per-family AI cost tracking with monthly and daily caps.

features.name: Open courses
features.detail: Publish any course under an open licence with its own public page.

features.name: Portable everything
features.detail: Export any course as a file, import one from any instance by link, or export a whole family.

features.name: Made for research tools
features.detail: Plain-text courses, llms.txt, a public JSON API and a sitemap.

features.name: No ads, no trackers
features.detail: Nothing tracks what learners do, and self-hosted data never leaves your box unless you connect an AI service.

roadmap.name: Interactive lesson types
roadmap.detail: Ordering, matching, sorting, number lines, fraction models, diagrams to label and branching scenarios.

roadmap.name: Speak your answer
roadmap.detail: Push to talk for early readers, with the transcript shown before anything is graded.

roadmap.name: Controller play
roadmap.detail: Play the learner world with a game controller.

roadmap.name: Language courses
roadmap.detail: Vocabulary cards, listen and choose, listen and repeat, translate, dialogue and graded readers are now in lessons with CEFR A1 to C2. French A1 and Spanish A1 ready. Next: more levels and languages.

roadmap.name: Desktop app
roadmap.detail: A downloadable app that runs offline, and a Steam release.

Families track their own children's progress

audiences.label: Developers and IT
audiences.title: An education platform you can read, run and extend
audiences.lead: AGPL-3.0, Node and Postgres in one Docker image, with any OpenAI-compatible model, Claude, Gemini or Ollama behind a task-routed AI layer. Courses are portable JSON with a public API.

needs.title: One command to run
needs.body: docker compose up -d starts the app and Postgres. An optional profile adds Ollama.

needs.title: A trust boundary you can audit
needs.body: Grading is server-side, answer keys never reach the browser, and every AI output passes a normalizer.

needs.title: Built to be consumed
needs.body: A public course API, plain-text courses, llms.txt, a sitemap and a portable course format.

needs.title: Room to contribute
needs.body: Hundreds of tests, documented architecture, and good first issues with file paths.

steps: Clone the repository
docker compose up -d
Point it at your AI endpoint or Ollama
Read the API docs and pick a good first issue
